{{Otheruses|Royal Palace}}
The '''Royal Palace''' was located in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kryndyn]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zelos II]]. [[Mandated Commander of the People of Zelos]] [[Galleros Nul]] resided in the Palace, and ran the government from there.
